auth.name: Your name
auth.panelTitle: Every WhatsApp conversation, in one shared inbox.
auth.panelLead: Connect your number, answer customers as a team, and send approved templates to the people who opted in.
auth.featConnectText: Meta's Embedded Signup, with every step saved and retryable.
auth.featTeamText: Assign chats, leave notes, and see read receipts in real time.
auth.featTemplatesText: Submit templates to Meta and track approval without leaving the app.
auth.twoFactorText: If it's on for your account, we'll ask for your 6-digit code next.

getStarted.title: Welcome, {{name}}
getStarted.intro: A few steps to start messaging your customers on WhatsApp.
getStarted.stepConnectHint: Use Meta's sign-up to link your WhatsApp Business Account.
getStarted.progressText: Connecting WhatsApp unlocks the inbox, templates and campaigns.
getStarted.progressTextDone: Your number is connected. Start a conversation from the inbox or send a template.
getStarted.stepVerifyHint: Use the link we emailed to you.
getStarted.featInboxText: Assign chats and reply as a team.
getStarted.featTemplatesText: Get approval for order and offer updates.
getStarted.stepMessageHint: Reply in the inbox or send an approved template.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.name: Display name
numbers.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{number}}? It stops sending and receiving, and frees a number on your plan. You can reconnect it later.
numbers.profileIntro: This is what customers see when they open your chat.
numbers.logoHint: Square, JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
numbers.intro: Phone numbers on your WhatsApp Business Accounts, with their health and limits.
numbers.qualityAlertHint: Customers blocked or reported recent messages. Pause marketing sends from this number until it recovers.
numbers.tiersHint: Meta raises your limit automatically while quality stays good.
numbers.profileSub: Shown to customers in WhatsApp for {{number}}

connect.title: Connect WhatsApp
connect.intro: You'll sign in with Facebook and choose or create your WhatsApp Business Account in a Meta window. Ecogo never sees your Facebook password.
connect.standardHint: A number not yet on WhatsApp, or one you will move off the WhatsApp app.
connect.coexistence: A number on the WhatsApp Business app
connect.coexistenceHint: Keep using the app on your phone. Ecogo imports your contacts and up to 6 months of chats.
connect.coexistenceLimits: Numbers on the Business app send at most 20 messages per second, and need WhatsApp Business app 2.24.17 or later.
connect.notConfigured: Connecting WhatsApp is not configured on this server yet.
connect.sdkNotReady: Meta's sign-up could not start. Reload the page and try again. If it keeps failing, turn off ad or privacy blockers for this site.
connect.popupClosed: The Meta window closed before sign-up finished. You can try again.
connect.noCode: Meta did not finish the sign-up. Please try again.
connect.standardPoint1: Full API access for inbox, templates and campaigns
connect.standardPoint2: Registration and two-step PIN handled for you
connect.standardPoint3: Ready to message in a few minutes
connect.coexistencePoint1: Replies from the phone appear in this inbox
connect.coexistencePoint2: Contacts and recent chat history imported
connect.need1: A Facebook account with admin access to your business
connect.need2: A phone number that can receive an SMS or voice call
connect.need3: Your business name, website and address

common.comingSoonBody: This screen is part of release 1 and is being built next.

templates.title: Templates
templates.newIntro: Meta reviews every template before you can send it. Most reviews finish within minutes.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create one, or sync the ones you made in WhatsApp Manager.
templates.name: Name
templates.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, for example order_shipped.
templates.bodyHint: Use {{1}}, {{2}} … for values you fill in when sending.
templates.sampleHint: JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB, MP4 up to 16 MB, or PDF up to 16 MB. Campaigns send their own file.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}} in every language? Meta will not let you reuse this name for 30 days.
templates.categoryHint_utility: Utility is for updates about an order or account the customer already has.
templates.categoryHint_marketing: Marketing is for offers and announcements; customers must have opted in.
templates.categoryHint_authentication: Authentication is for one-time passcodes only.
templates.samplesHint: Meta needs one for each variable
templates.previewEmpty: Your message appears here as you type.
templates.check_name: Name uses only lowercase, numbers and underscores
templates.check_samples: A sample is set for every variable
templates.checksFoot: Status updates live from Meta after you submit

send.title: Send a message
send.intro: Send a test message from a connected number. The inbox will replace this screen.
send.mode_template_hint: Works any time. Needs an approved template.
send.mode_text_hint: Only within 24 hours of the customer's last message.
send.noTemplates: No approved templates for this number yet.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.closedHint: The customer has not written in 24 hours. Only an approved template can be sent.
inbox.placeholder: Type a message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, / inserts a quick reply.
inbox.fileType: WhatsApp does not accept this file type.

developers.confirmRotate: Make a new signing secret? Deliveries are signed with it at once, so update your server too.
developers.title: Developers
developers.intro: API keys, webhooks and delivery logs for your integration.
developers.copyNow: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
developers.usage: Send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Each key can make 60 requests per second.
developers.confirmRevoke: Revoke the key “{{name}}”? Systems using it stop working at once.
developers.noAccess: Only owners, admins and developers can manage API keys.
developers.webhooksIntro: Ecogo posts events to your HTTPS endpoint, signed with the endpoint's secret in the Ecogo-Signature header. Failed deliveries are retried for about 24 hours.
developers.secretNow: Copy this signing secret now. It will not be shown again.
developers.confirmDelete: Delete the endpoint {{url}}? It stops receiving events at once.
developers.successRate: {{pct}}% delivered in the last 24 hours ({{count}} shown)
developers.quickstartHint: Replace the key, number and template with your own.
developers.keysSub: A key is shown once when you create it
developers.webhooksSub: Signed with HMAC-SHA256, retried for 24 hours on failure

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.languageHint: For templates, for example en, hi or ta.
contacts.optedInNow: This customer agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from us
contacts.evidenceHint: For example: signed up at the shop counter
contacts.fileHint: Needs a header row with a phone column. Name, language, tags (separated by ;) and opt_in (yes or no) are recognised; other columns become fields.
contacts.countryCode: Country code for numbers without one
contacts.confirmConsent: Everyone marked opt_in = yes agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from us
contacts.importResult: {{rows}} rows: {{created}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{skipped}} skipped. {{opted_in}} opt-ins and {{opted_out}} opt-outs recorded.
contacts.intro: People who can message you, with their tags and WhatsApp opt-in.
contacts.summary: {{total}} contacts · {{optedIn}} opted in to WhatsApp messages
contacts.optOutText: A STOP reply opts the contact out straight away, and campaigns skip anyone without a recorded opt-in.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. A campaign sends an approved template to the contacts with the tags you pick.
campaigns.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can see and send campaigns.
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.limitHint: Messaging limit {{tier}}: sending pauses when the number reaches it and resumes as the 24-hour window frees up.
campaigns.noNumber: Connect a WhatsApp number first, from Numbers.
campaigns.noTemplates: This number's account has no approved templates. Create one under Templates.
campaigns.variablesHint: Type text, or insert a contact field. Add a fallback after | for contacts without the field, for example {{contact.first_name|there}}; contacts with an empty field and no fallback are skipped.
campaigns.noTags: No tags yet. Tag contacts on the Contacts screen first.
campaigns.audienceCounts: {{eligible}} of {{total}} will get it. Skipped: {{opted_out}} opted out, {{blocked}} blocked, {{no_opt_in}} with no opt-in record.
campaigns.confirmCancel: Cancel this campaign? Messages already sent are not recalled.
campaigns.notExpanded: Recipients are listed once the campaign starts.
campaigns.intro: Send approved templates to opted-in contacts, paced within your messaging limit.
campaigns.kpiDeliveryHint: Delivered or read, of messages sent
campaigns.pacedTitle: Sends are paced within your messaging limit
campaigns.pacedText: Your number can reach {{limit}} unique users every 24 hours. Larger audiences are spread across days automatically, and contacts without an opt-in are skipped.

analytics.medianResponse_one: Median first response {{time}}, across {{count}} answered customer message.
analytics.medianResponse_other: Median first response {{time}}, across {{count}} answered customer messages.

analytics.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can see analytics.
analytics.unpriced_one: {{count}} billable message went to a country without a rate here, so it is not in the estimate.
analytics.unpriced_other: {{count}} billable messages went to countries without a rate here, so they are not in the estimate.

analytics.kpiCostFoot_other: {{count}} billable messages, billed by Meta directly

settings.title: Settings
settings.rolesHelp: Owners manage everything, including billing. Admins manage the team, numbers, templates and campaigns. Agents answer chats in the inbox. Developers manage API keys and webhooks.
settings.inviteSent: Invite emailed to {{email}}. You can also share this link; it works for 7 days.
settings.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from this workspace? They lose access right away.
settings.timeZoneHint: Analytics days and campaign schedules follow this time zone.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change these.
settings.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Your other sessions are logged out.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were logged out.
settings.twoStepOff: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, asked for every time you log in.
settings.twoStepOn: On. Logging in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
settings.twoStepScan: Add this key to your authenticator app, or open the link on your phone, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.twoStepDisableHint: Enter a current code to turn it off.
settings.twoStepAdmin: Platform admins must keep it on.
settings.retentionHint: Older messages and their media files are deleted every day and cannot be recovered. Reports keep their totals.
settings.intro: Manage your workspace, team, billing and security.
settings.roleDesc_owner: Connects WhatsApp, invites the team, and manages billing and API keys
settings.roleDesc_admin: Manages the team, numbers, templates, contacts and campaigns
settings.roleDesc_agent: Replies in the inbox and adds notes to conversations
settings.metaFeesNote: Meta message fees are billed by Meta directly.

invite.otherAccount: This invite is for {{email}}, but you are logged in as {{current}}. Log out, then open the link again.

admin.title: Platform overview
admin.needs2fa: Turn on two-step verification before using the admin console.
admin.deliveries24: Webhook deliveries to the customer, last 24 hours
admin.suspendReason: Reason for suspending (kept in the audit log)
admin.reactivateReason: Reason for reactivating (kept in the audit log)
admin.conversationsHelp: Message content is hidden. Reading a conversation needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
admin.viewReason: Why do you need to read this conversation? (support ticket or case)
admin.noWebhooks: No webhooks from Meta in this window.
admin.rateHelp: Rates are in hundredths of a paisa per billable message (7846 is ₹0.7846). A rate applies from its start date until a later one replaces it; * is the fallback for countries without their own rate. A month cannot be billed while a country has no rate.
admin.reconHelp: Each day, our billable message counts and their cost at the rate card are compared with what Meta reports for the WABA. Differences of a couple of messages are ignored.
admin.reconNone: Nothing to show yet. The check runs once a day for workspaces with a connected number.
admin.invoiceTruncated: Showing the newest 500; narrow the dates to see the rest.
admin.plansHelp: Prices are in rupees per month. A plan is offered to customers once it is shown and has its Razorpay plan ID: create a monthly plan with the same amount in the Razorpay dashboard and paste its ID here.
admin.seatRazorpayPlan: Razorpay plan ID for one extra seat (optional)
admin.aiReplies: AI replies per month (0 for none)
admin.badPrice: Enter prices in rupees, for example 2999.
admin.deletionsIntro: Requests Meta sends when someone removes the app in Facebook. Delete anything held for the person, then mark the request done; they can follow it on a public status page.
admin.errorsByCodeHint: Across the {{count}} most recent errors loaded below
admin.intro: Every tenant, webhook and Meta API call across the platform. Staff only.
admin.auditSub: Every staff action, with its reason

bots.title: Chatbots
bots.empty: No chatbots yet. A chatbot answers customers automatically and hands the conversation to your team when it cannot help.
bots.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can build chatbots.
bots.name: Name
bots.triggersHelp: A bot starts when a customer's message matches any of these. It stays out of conversations your team has taken over.
bots.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Messages it already sent stay in the inbox.
bots.trigger_first_message: First message from a new customer
bots.buttonIdPlaceholder: Id of the button that starts the bot
bots.fixFirst: Fix the problems listed below first.
bots.unreachable: Faded nodes are not reached from the start.
bots.variablesHelp: Text can use {{answer}} for a saved answer, {{contact.name}} and {{contact.phone}}.
bots.handoffHelp: Sent with the bot.handoff webhook. The conversation moves to Pending for your team.
bots.noSessions: This chatbot has not run yet.
bots.aiInstructionsHelp: For example: keep answers short, or mention that we deliver only in Bengaluru.
bots.aiThresholdHelp: 0 to 1. Below this the AI does not answer and the bot follows the path on the right.

knowledge.title: AI knowledge
knowledge.lead: Teach the AI what your business offers. Chatbots with an AI step answer customers only from what is here, and hand over to your team when they are not sure.
knowledge.ownersOnly: Only owners and admins can change the AI knowledge.
knowledge.notConfigured: No language model is set up on this server yet, so the AI hands every question to your team. Ask your administrator to set the AI key.
knowledge.usage: AI replies this billing period: {{used}} of {{limit}}
knowledge.noAllowance: Your plan does not include AI replies. Choose a plan with AI replies in Settings.
knowledge.empty: No sources yet. Add your FAQs, a page of text, a web page or a document.
knowledge.question: Question
knowledge.urlHelp: Only this one page is read. Pages built with JavaScript may come out empty.
knowledge.fileHelp: A .txt, .md, .csv or .html file up to 2 MB. PDFs are not read.
knowledge.reason_no_knowledge: Nothing in the knowledge matches this question.
knowledge.reason_low_confidence: The AI was not sure enough to answer, so a chatbot would hand over to your team.
knowledge.reason_limit: Your plan's AI replies for this period are used up.
knowledge.reason_error: The AI could not be reached. Try again.
knowledge.reason_not_configured: No language model is set up on this server.

flows.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change Flows.
flows.name: Name

flows.confirmDeprecate: Deprecate {{name}}? Customers can no longer open it.

flows.noSubmissions: No one has submitted a Flow yet.
